steps.text: Where are the others?

steps.name: Clan Leader A
steps.text: The people of the Great Wood Tribe are gone. I heard that leader was defeated by an outsider.

steps.name: Peta
steps.text: The Firestone and Thick Tail Tribes were defeated by an stranger carrying a pile of weapons on her back.

steps.name: Clan Leader A
steps.text: Some of the tribes decided to join up with Zumama.

steps.name: Clan Leader B
steps.text: The truth is Zumama's managed to drum up a formidable front. If I weren't with Gavial, I might have gone to Zumama myself.
Doesn't matter.
Your tribes will be enough.

steps.name: Clan Leader B
steps.text: Hey, can we really challenge Zumama on our own?
Yes.
Gavial can definitely beat Zumama's giant machine. Then, I will become the Great Chief and force Gavial to stay.

steps.name: Peta
steps.text: Peta thinks that is not a good idea.
But this is the only way to make her stay.
Don't forget why we formed 'Gavial's Will'!
'Gavial's Will' is not just a tribe. It is an alliance dedicated to the vision of Gavial as the Great Chief!

steps.name: Clan Leader B
steps.text: I agree with Tomimi. I'll only recognize Gavial as the Great Chief.

steps.name: Clan Leader A
steps.text: That's right, Gavial should be the one to lead us!

steps.name: Clan Leader C
steps.text: Hah, if I disagreed I wouldn't be here either!

steps.name: Peta
steps.text: ...Peta doesn't like it, but Peta will follow.
Alright, you head over to Zumama's tribe and wait outside for me, got it?

steps.name: Other Clan Leaders
steps.text: Yes.
Right. This is all for Gavial.

steps.name: Other Clan Leaders
steps.text: All for Gavial!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Doctor! Everyone! Great, I finally found you guys!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: *Sigh*, Doctor, you had me worried.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Blaze, why are you wearing your swimsuit... and carrying some kid on your back?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I ran into this little girl on my way over here. She started hitting me for some reason.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I kicked her ass, of course, and beat down all her friends too.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Gotta hand it to her, she's not bad in a fight, didn't go down easy. So I brought her along. I figured you could help me ask why she wanted to fight me.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's Kemar. She probably just thought you looked strong. She just loves fighting.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hah. That means something, coming from you.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I don't love fighting. I'm just a hands-on problem solver.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Whatever.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: ...Where... am I...?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Morning, Kemar.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Gavial?! What are you doing here?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You bumped into my friend, fought her, and lost.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Heh, welcome back, kid.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, Gavial. What's she doing? What's with this bowing?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Kemar, what gives?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I felt a greater strength from her than anything I ever felt from Zumama.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I'm not interested in you anymore, Gavial. Looks like you can talk to her, so please, ask her to teach me.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, she wants you to teach her.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I guess she thinks you're strong, so she wants to become your disciple or something.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...Doctor, what do I do?! I've never been in a situation like this before!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ugh, how about we just let her follow us for now?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Sure. Hey, Kemar, come with us.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: But call me Flint.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Come to think of it, what happened to the ceremony?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, why don't you explain it to Blaze?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She'll let her people get Oripathy just to build her machines?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I won't stand by and let that happen.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What are we waiting for, Doctor? Let's go!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Wait, we still got somewhere to be!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh?
